listing.title: Cardinal Mug, Watercolor Winter Bird Coffee Mug, Snowy Pine and Holly All Over Print, Christmas Gift for Bird Lovers, Cozy Winter Mug
listing.description: Red cardinals perch on snow-dusted pine boughs among holly, pinecones and falling snow, painted in layered watercolor all the way around the mug on a warm cream background. A quiet, cozy winter mug for bird lovers, from the first snowfall through Christmas and the long winter after.
